text: minervini: "Inverted 50/200; day_vol 0.94 on the move." That is the longer-trend context Steenbarger asks for, and I own it: price above all averages with the long stack still inverted means a markup leaving a lower range, not a trend (C16). An advance on day_vol 0.94 lacks effort (C5). So I do not buy here. I support only a held test of the Creek (structure_shift_ref) followed by a sign-of-strength bar on >= 1.2x volume. A daily close under structure_shift_ref-0.5atr fails the move and I drop it.
